soil.name: SoilGrids
soil.access_rule: freeze median-prediction COG/WebDAV payloads before colour inference; do not rely on the beta REST service
soil.depth_aggregation: thickness-weighted 0-30 cm mean for each variable, then global terrestrial z-score
soil.role: multivariate edaphic turnover for local-adaptation and pigment-stress hypotheses

topography.name: EarthEnv Global Topography
topography.role: terrain contrast and rugged intervening terrain

hydrography.name: HydroRIVERS / HydroSHEDS
hydrography.version_rule: record exact fixed release and river-size attribute threshold before colour outcome

marine_land_mask.name: Natural Earth 1:10m Land
marine_land_mask.role: great-circle marine-gap fraction including island/strait separation

direct_pollination.name: Global Biotic Interactions
direct_pollination.release_rule: use a stable versioned integrated dataset and record DOI plus payload checksum before colour outcome
direct_pollination.role: direct pollination/flower-visitation community turnover where spatial coverage is adequate

pollinator_occurrence_proxy.name: GBIF
pollinator_occurrence_proxy.release_rule: create an occurrence download with DOI before colour outcome and preserve query/taxon keys/checksum
pollinator_occurrence_proxy.role: broad independent pollinator-guild occurrence turnover proxy

plant_sympatry_occurrence.name: GBIF
plant_sympatry_occurrence.release_rule: create a separate vascular-plant occurrence download with DOI before colour outcome and preserve query/taxon keys/checksum
plant_sympatry_occurrence.role: outcome-blind 100-km occupancy, sympatry and matched-allopatry frame for G5
plant_sympatry_occurrence.independence_rule: exclude iNaturalist flower-photo occurrence identifiers used in colour measurement wherever cross-source identifiers allow
